scope: Read-only source review and isolated local fixture tests; no cluster mutation or real DB contents read

review.finalSnapshotPublication: hardlink after backup, integrity and deadline checks; existing final never overwritten
review.localTransfer: 1MiB chunks + short tail, perchunk and whole SHA256, streamedgzip, finalSQLiteintegrity
review.errorConfidentiality: subprocess stdout/stderr and parsing/validation messages excluded from CLI failure diagnostics
review.journal: 0600 private content with operational paths/status, no DB bodies
review.cancellation: local kubectl killed on budget; remote process cancellation not guaranteed
review.hardWallclock: synchronous SQLite/FS stages and remote exec may continue between checks; no guarantee of absolute wall-clock kill
